exact_blockers: The pinned ledger and catalog identify egs/noise_suppression/pretrained_ckpt/streaming/dpcrn_mamba_v1.onnx as 2,282,757 bytes with SHA-256 eabdca9fa7b0cc66c839d41e2fe07e409c9c09ad476e4dd0681a7bc63f04bfab and its manifest as 3,545 bytes with SHA-256 8846667c3498ec11dbd89f60c500badfdfa08cc6cc596e9b7f97dd1370b0a533 under source revision 79fad1f1c753da5e40a0cbb00c6507c9fce2db3a. The bytes are present in the external research checkout and were re-hashed there, but the ledger records no model_revision and no immutable retrieval record, no caller-held copy exists in this SDK worktree, and the package neither reads nor admits the bytes.

The exact runtime is absent and unpinned here: puresound-streaming 0.1.0 is a source package in the external checkout without a built wheel/sdist digest, and onnxruntime 1.24.1 cannot be imported by the pinned CPython 3.12.16 interpreter (ModuleNotFoundError); the adapter requirements lock (numpy 2.2.6, onnxruntime 1.24.1, soundfile 0.13.1) is not installed, and adapters/puresound-dpcrn-mamba/run.py is not executed.

Apache-2.0 is recorded for the original PureSound code, SDK, configuration, documentation and model-zoo checkpoints/ONNX exports, and the upstream NOTICE permits commercial use and redistribution under the license, but it excludes third-party material and datasets/audio recordings; exact training-data provenance and third-party dataset terms are not established, and no artifact-specific redistribution/product-use legal review or decision is recorded. Apache-2.0 metadata alone is not qualification clearance.

No rights-cleared held-out real cohort, independent clean-reference scorer, permitted listening result, target-runtime timing/memory/throughput measurement, approved exact reference output vector or benchmark/release result exists; every release gate remains blocked.
